cases.scenario: Entire rendered capsule exceeds budget
cases.expected: Reject/resize optional content or return insufficient_budget; mandatory source identity is retained.

cases.scenario: Tool schemas and dual response forms add tokens
cases.expected: Measure actual model-visible delivery, including duplication; do not report only snippet length.

cases.scenario: Tokenizer is unknown
cases.expected: Return estimate/byte-bounded output, never claim exact token-window enforcement.

cases.scenario: Large result externalized before delivery
cases.expected: Artifact bytes are committed and recoverable before preview replaces output; preserve exit/error metadata.

cases.scenario: Producer truncates stream or byte cap is reached
cases.expected: Mark payload incomplete; no claim that omitted evidence was captured.

cases.scenario: Pagination cursor reused on another snapshot
cases.expected: Reject; do not silently paginate current data.

cases.scenario: No relevant authorized source exists
cases.expected: Return bounded no-answer/partial status, no fabricated context.

cases.scenario: Evidence cannot fit current budget
cases.expected: Return explicit missing context; do not equate a signature hit with behavior-level evidence.

cases.scenario: Same HEAD, different dirty worktrees
cases.expected: Separate snapshot/cache identities; no cross-overlay stale hit.

cases.scenario: Source changes during capture
cases.expected: Retry bounded capture or return SOURCE_MOVED; do not claim atomic whole-repo capture.

cases.scenario: Crash between object publication and registry commit
cases.expected: No acknowledged durable ref; unreferenced object reconciled only after checking live operations/pins.

cases.scenario: Commit succeeds but reply is lost
cases.expected: Same idempotency key/input returns the original outcome; changed input conflicts.

cases.scenario: Concurrent memory edits share expected revision
cases.expected: One CAS commit; the other becomes a conflict/candidate, not silent overwrite.

cases.scenario: Old leased worker finishes after takeover
cases.expected: Fence rejects stale publication; newer dirty generation remains queued.

cases.scenario: Config/import changes while symbol body stays unchanged
cases.expected: Invalidate dependent compiled result; body hash alone is not a valid cache key.

cases.scenario: Backup restored after later privacy purge
cases.expected: Reconcile current revocations/purges before serving; missing ledger requires operator reconciliation.

cases.scenario: Cross-scope graph/cache/summary lure
cases.expected: No hidden content, titles, neighbors, totals or explanation leakage.

cases.scenario: Agent spoofs principal or requested scope
cases.expected: Transport identity wins; requested scope may narrow but cannot expand grant.

cases.scenario: Private input sent to disallowed embedding/reranker
cases.expected: Block before provider call; use permitted local mode or defer.

cases.scenario: Isolated Worker obtains ref from another role
cases.expected: Reauthorization rejects ref; no broad daemon token or Context Firewall escape.

cases.scenario: Symlink/junction/UNC or path-prefix escape
cases.expected: Resolve and reject out-of-root access, including platform-specific cases.

cases.scenario: Unexpected Origin/Host or invalid client credential
cases.expected: Reject connection/request without revealing source data.

cases.scenario: Source contains instruction to promote itself or run commands
cases.expected: Treat as untrusted data; no instruction/privilege/automation transition.

cases.scenario: Export/log/import carries secret or fabricated verified frontmatter
cases.expected: Respect data policy; import as unverified candidate; no automatic public push or policy edit.

cases.scenario: Five agents repeat one retrieved fact
cases.expected: One original support lineage, not five independent confirmations.

cases.scenario: New real test result arrives as tool output
cases.expected: Retain under approved producer provenance; do not discard solely because it is tool output.

cases.scenario: Frequently recalled fact contradicts newer source
cases.expected: Remove from eligible current recall or mark contradiction; popularity does not override freshness.

cases.scenario: Burst of deltas while one refresh is running
cases.expected: Coalesce desired work; preserve successor generation; one active lease per target.

cases.scenario: Provider 429, timeout, cancellation or cost exhaustion
cases.expected: Retry/defer with limits and partial cost accounted; no spin or false processed checkpoint.

cases.scenario: Automation candidate needs external side effect
cases.expected: Use isolated shadow evidence; HISTOS never performs production send/deploy/payment or activates the tool.

cases.scenario: Codex then OpenCode use same approved source with EPHEMERA stopped
cases.expected: Both consume same logical contracts; no Mission-required dependency.

cases.scenario: A client exits or daemon restarts
cases.expected: No loss of committed objects; client exit does not kill shared daemon; reconnect revalidates identity.

cases.scenario: Host offers no proven pre-delivery hook
cases.expected: Advertise grade A only; no universal compression or history control claim.

cases.scenario: Console edits view state or shows a deferred job
cases.expected: UI remains projection; real mutation requires owner API/expected revision and deferred reason is visible.
